not_in_scope_here: registering the retriever in a running Context Builder deployment, which is operator configuration rather than D1 evidence
the operator CLI surface, S21D1-063 in wave W6b

s21d1_055_context_source.backward_compatibility: SPRINT11_SOURCE_TYPES excludes the new type, so the Sprint 11 fixtures and their clients stay valid. Covered by a test that asserts the exclusion and a test that every source type declares a trust class.
s21d1_055_context_source.schema_change: one added enum value across the 11 context schemas; nothing removed and no field changed
s21d1_055_context_source.why_unverified_by_default: fail closed. A candidate earns VERIFIED per retrieval by resolving its hashes, never by belonging to a source type. A source type that grants trust would make a corrupt store indistinguishable from a healthy one.

candidate_properties.content_hash: the edit path's hash, so the candidate is identified by the suggestion it carries
candidate_properties.provenance: pair identity, revision and the successful graph's content hash

s21d1_056_retriever.empty_set_health: degraded, not unavailable, because the deterministic path keeps working without graph memory
fail_closed_behaviours: a request whose purpose is not repair or advisory receives nothing
a pair whose group or task signature appears in the request text is dropped before ranking, so a repair request cannot retrieve its own answer
VERIFIED requires the source outcome to be accepted, an artifact id to be known, and the verifier to resolve it
a verifier that raises degrades the candidate to UNVERIFIED rather than propagating; a corrupt store stays visible instead of looking like an empty corpus
a subquery for another source type raises
a set cancellation event raises CancelledError before any work
s21d1_056_retriever.location_rationale: the owning subsystem holds its own retriever, matching strategies/retrieval.py rather than adding a second home under context/

s21d1_057_advisory_path.bundle: assembled through the real assemble_bundle with the standard provider profile and token estimator
s21d1_057_advisory_path.deterministic_fallback: an empty retriever reports DEGRADED and returns nothing; the caller's deterministic path is unaffected
s21d1_057_advisory_path.exercised: repair request -> retriever -> safety filter -> ranking -> assembled bundle
s21d1_057_advisory_path.ranking: graph candidates pass through the existing rank_candidates with the standard ranking profile and remain non-required and non-pinned
s21d1_057_advisory_path.safety_filter: 0 exclusions; nothing in a graph candidate is unsafe content
